description.value: Thai Food Near Me is an authentic Thai restaurant on Fort Street in downtown Victoria, serving a broad menu of traditional appetizers, curries, stir-fries, and noodle dishes prepared with fresh ingredients and classic techniques. The restaurant emphasizes communal, family-style dining rooted in Thailand's regional culinary heritage, and also offers online ordering for takeout and delivery.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an operational Thai restaurant at 102-915 Fort Street, Victoria BC, with phone 250-384-2971 and email thaifoodnearmebc@gmail.com. The menu lists multiple tofu dishes as meat alternatives, confirming vegetarian options; the website's online ordering section and delivery language confirm takeout is available. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Business name 'Thai Food Near Me' is an SEO-optimized phrase rather than a conventional business name; may be difficult for cyclists to search or reference by name.
OSM record contains no address or phone number; both were sourced from website only and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational Thai restaurant in downtown Victoria confirmed by website content with a full menu and contact details. Useful stop for cyclists in the area.
